mapper.sql: id,order_id,order_line_id,product_id,customer_id,merchant_id,quantity,merchandise_amount, shipping_amount,currency,kind,status,reason,decision,tracking_number,refund_number,return_shipping_cost, received_quantity,last_error,warehouse_id,outbound_id,warehouse_return_status, approved_quantity,approved_merchandise_amount, (SELECT w.phase FROM return_exception_work_orders w WHERE w.case_id=line_after_sales.id) AS work_order_phase
mapper.select: SELECT FROM line_after_sales WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM line_after_sales WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT FROM line_after_sales WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT FROM line_after_sales ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM line_after_sales WHERE order_id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO line_after_sale_order_locks(order_id) VALUES (#{orderId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_id=order_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM line_after_sales WHERE status IN ('RETURN_SENT','PREPARING','REFUNDING','RESTOCKING','RELEASING', 'EXCHANGE_OUT_OF_STOCK','EXCHANGE_SHIPPING') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT 30
mapper.update: UPDATE line_after_sales SET tracking_number=#{trackingNumber},return_shipping_cost=#{returnShippingCost}, status='RETURN_SENT',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND customer_id=#{customerId} AND status='WAITING_RETURN'

UPDATE line_after_sales SET warehouse_id=#{warehouseId},outbound_id=#{outboundId}, warehouse_return_status=#{warehouseStatus},received_quantity=#{receivedQuantity},status=#{to}, last_error=NULL,next_attempt_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,5,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RETURN_SENT' AND (warehouse_return_status IS NULL OR (warehouse_return_status='WAITING_RECEIPT' AND #{warehouseStatus}<>'WAITING_RECEIPT') OR (warehouse_return_status='RECEIVED' AND #{warehouseStatus} IN ('PASSED','FAILED')))

UPDATE line_after_sales SET status=#{to},decision=#{note},next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND status='WAITING_MERCHANT' AND warehouse_return_status='PASSED' AND received_quantity=quantity AND outbound_id IS NOT NULL AND warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
UPDATE line_after_sales SET next_attempt_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,5,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RETURN_SENT'

UPDATE line_after_sales SET approved_quantity=#{quantity},approved_merchandise_amount=#{amount}, status='PREPARING',decision=#{note},next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='REVIEW_REQUIRED' AND refund_number IS NULL AND approved_quantity IS NULL AND kind='RETURN' AND warehouse_return_status IN ('SHORT_RECEIVED','FAILED') AND received_quantity >= #{quantity} AND outbound_id IS NOT NULL AND warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
UPDATE line_after_sales SET status=#{to},decision=#{note},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='REVIEW_REQUIRED' AND refund_number IS NULL
